scripts.build: pnpm --recursive --if-present run build && pnpm run build:go
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint:contracts && pnpm run generate:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:java && pnpm run security:check
scripts.generate:check: pnpm run generate && git diff --exit-code -- gen/proto packages/runner-protocol/src/gen packages/api-client/src/gen
scripts.lint:contracts: buf lint proto/provenance/runner/v1 && pnpm run lint:openapi
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm --recursive --if-present run test && pnpm run test:python && pnpm run test:vectors && pnpm run test:openapi && pnpm run test:proto
scripts.security:check: pnpm audit --audit-level high && go -C gen/proto run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.7.0 ./...
